newsitem.title: USA: Greenbriar sees approval on stock issuance.
newsitem.headline: Greenbriar sees approval on stock issuance.

text.p: Greenbriar Corp on Tuesday said two of its board members, who together control more than 73.2 percent of the outstanding shares, plan to vote to approve the issuance of stock needed to buy American Care Communities Inc.
Greenbriar, formerly Medical Resource Cos of America, said it would seek shareholder approval to issue 1.3 million shares of common stock on December 30, the same day stockholders will on the merger.
The boards of both companies already have approved the $20 million deal, the company said.
Floyd Rhoades, the current chairman, president and chief executive of American Care, was named president and chief executive of Greenbriar.
James Gilley, who will continue as Greenbriar's chairman, said the company was aggressively pursuing other acquisitions.
When the merger is completed, Greenbriar will own or lease 33 residences with about 2,600 units in 10 states.
